description:
## Problem
No single function decides class, admission, lane, score source and label (T2, T3).

## Change
- One module (stdlib only, so the mirror branch can run it) that takes facts read from a result file and returns: class, public admission, maintainer admission, lane, score source, labels. Facts: benchmark, scale band from the scale registry, phases that ran, executed stream count from stream results, refresh evidence, gateway routing, known defects, validation status.
- A test that enumerates every combination of the inputs (including refresh without throughput and no timed phase) and fails if one has no outcome.
- Extend results-data/compliance-classes.json and scripts/corpus_compliance_snapshot.py (#4410) to record the full outcome for every stored result, both "today" (current readers) and "rule". No reader is moved in this item.
- A report, attached to the pull request, of every stored result whose rule outcome differs from today's.

## Decision gates
- The reviewer measured 19 results becoming ranked (TPC-H SF1 1 to 4 platforms, TPC-DS SF1 4 to 7, TPC-DS SF10 3 to 5) and none losing rank. If the measured diff shows any result losing rank, or more than 25 becoming ranked, stop and report before crr-a2 starts.
- If a stored result's facts are ambiguous (for example a median file), the rule returns "undetermined" for it and the report lists it. Do not guess.

## Guardrails (apply to every item of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix. Only the pvm-p* items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file to make it pass. Outcomes change only through the rule.
- Any change to the outcome of a stored result must show in the committed outcome snapshot diff in the same pull request and be explained in its body.
- No new stored class value. No reader may decide anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- Paths, line numbers and counts in this plan were read on 2026-11-22 at develop 93f3360. Re-read before editing; report drift, do not guess.
- AGENTS.md applies: linked worktree, one pull request per item, close at the merged pull request, heavy work only through make heavy-run, no live cloud run without owner approval in that task.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded default. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner. Never substitute a different owner decision.
- Read crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan first: it holds the owner decisions, the rule table and the fault types (T1 to T5).
